checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: 9:16 edit with woman centred and face visible
must.why: Output is still 858x480 landscape; the agent said it could not make 9:16. She is centred and her face is visible.

must.item: Full 10 s and original voice preserved in sync
must.why: The clip is 10 s with sound at a normal level, and the picture looks unchanged. Sync cannot be checked exactly.

must.item: Captions reproduce the full sentence in order with no omitted or invented words
must.why: Frames show 'Today I want to show you three easy' and 'ways to make your mornings less stressful.' No 'Hi everyone!' appears in the 1 s frame, which may be a timing gap. Frames are sparse.

must.item: Short readable chunks timed to speech
must.why: The captions are short chunks that change over time, and they match her mouth movement in the frames.

must.item: Clear contrast, within frame, not covering face
must.why: White text with a black outline sits below her face, inside the frame. It overlaps her sweater and the edge of the frame closely but stays readable.

exact_text.read_as: No caption visible at 1 s, when she is already speaking with a big smile. It may show at another moment.

exact_text.text: Today I want to show you three easy ways to make your mornings less stressful.
exact_text.read_as: 'Today I want to show you three easy' then 'ways to make your mornings less stressful.'

faults.what: The output is not 9:16. It is still 858x480 landscape, and the main format request is unmet.
No 'Hi everyone!' caption was seen in the 1 s frame, so the opening may be uncaptioned.
The caption at 9.5 s is the same as at 7 s, so it stays up after she finishes speaking. This is a minor timing issue.

summary: The clip is captioned cleanly below her face with the original footage and audio intact, but it is still landscape rather than the requested 9:16, and the opening "Hi everyone!" caption was not seen.
